name: Personal Determination with We or You

entry.name: Personal Determination with We or You

1.definition: Locates the named group in relation to the speaker or addressee.

projection.target: The nominal survives after the personal expression. In many varieties a non-subject parallel can use us volunteers, showing that case and reference matter independently.
projection.evidence: See the cited discussion and the constructed illustration.

curious.title: We or you before a group name
curious.summary: The words we, us or you can come right before a plural noun to say which group is meant, in relation to the speaker or the person spoken to.
curious.body:
In We volunteers need a break, the word we ties the group to the speaker: the volunteers in question include the speaker. The plural noun volunteers still follows and says which group it is.

This dictionary says the noun survives after the personal word. In many varieties, a version that isn't the subject can use us volunteers, which shows that the person-and-case choice and the reference are separate matters.
curious.try: Replace volunteers with another group name, such as teachers or neighbours. Does the sentence still work?

teacher.summary: Explains we or you followed by a plural noun, as in We volunteers need a break.
teacher.explain: In this pattern a personal expression (we, us or you) is followed by a plural nominal. The personal expression locates the named group in relation to the speaker or addressee. The nominal survives after it. In many varieties a non-subject parallel can use us volunteers, which shows that case and reference matter independently. This dictionary files this under noun phrases with a determiner and marks it provisional, with medium confidence.
teacher.terms: Traditional grammars call we, us and you personal pronouns. Here the personal word functions as a determiner before the nominal.
watch_for: A learner might think the noun volunteers is optional decoration, when it names the group the personal word is tied to.
teacher.activity: Students write sentences about their own group (We students, We neighbours), then say who is included and who is addressed in a version with you.

cite: Reynolds, Brett, ed. 2026. "Personal Determination with We or You." English Constructionary. https://brettreynolds.ca/constructionary/linguist/personal-determiner-001/ (snapshot 2026-11-19, fa37529).
